messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Increased error rate observed in serving runtime during model warmup on us-west-2-prod. Symptoms: repeated OOM at load, CUDA driver errors, and container restarts across 3 nodes. Affected model: gptx-13b (hosted). Auto-mitigation triggered: diverting new warmups to smaller variants. Paging eng-sre oncall.

marta: I'm on it. seeing node flaps in the cluster (node-uw2-gpu-07, -09, -11). kube events show CrashLoopBackOff for runtime pods. :frowning_face:

omar: grabbing logs now. initial indicators look like deserialization failures during artifact unpack + kernel compile timeouts. stack shows CUDA failures on init.

ryan: tagging @lena @devon — this is impacting a handful of customer routes (A/B experiments using gptx-13b). CS flagged two customers with elevated error rates.

lena: confirmed customer impact: 2 customers (~0.3% of traffic overall) hitting 5xx on generation endpoints. Drafting comms.

devon: logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-14T18:34:02Z] model-loader: loading artifact /mnt/models/gptx-13b/weights.tar
[2026-03-14T18:34:07Z] deserializer: failed to mmap shard0: Input/output error
[2026-03-14T18:34:07Z] compile: nvrtc compile timeout after 120s
[2026-03-14T18:34:07Z] runtime: cuInit failed: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_FAILED
[2026-03-14T18:34:07Z] runtime: OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 12.4GiB on GPU 0
```

marta: that nvrtc timeout + cuInit error combo looks like a driver-side instability on those nodes, probably exacerbated by concurrent warmups. We got a warmup stampede at 18:33.

sre-bot: Auto-mitigation actions executed: 
- traffic_routing: shifted 40% of new requests to gptx-7b-quant (compatible fallback)
- warmup_throttle: paused parallel warmups on affected pool
- eviction_policy: increased aggressive eviction for prefix/KV cache on us-west-2-prod

omar: manual checks: node kernel logs on node-uw2-gpu-07 show repeated GPU driver NVML resets. Restarting node driver now.

ops: performing rolling cordon+drain of node-uw2-gpu-07 and -09. Will replace with spare nodes. ETA ~18m.

devon: I'm also bumping the model loader timeout and disabling on-demand compile for gptx-13b temp. patch applied to runtime config: ``compile_timeout_ms=60000`` -> ``120000`` and ``nvrtc_fallback=false`` -> ``true`` for affected pool.

lena: can we get a temporary rate limit on bulk warmups from the API side? A few customers are re-requesting weight preloads repeatedly.

marta: +1. I've added a per-customer warmup cooldown: 30m in frontdoor rules for those routes.

ryan: CS update: Emily from ops-accounts confirmed both customers are seeing transient errors but will accept limited degradation if we provide ETA. Emily is drafting a short note.

cs-emily: sending note now: "We're aware of intermittent 5xx errors for inference on gptx-13b. We've routed most traffic to a stable fallback and expect restoration within 45 minutes. Will follow up once fully stable."

omar: after driver restart on -07 we still see one pod failing due to shard deserialization OSError. Running `sha256sum` on the artifact shows mismatch for shard2. Possible artifact corruption.

devon: good catch. Fetching artifact from s3 backup and verifying. If corrupt, we'll rotate to the verified copy and trigger controlled warmup on a single node.

sre-bot: Note: automated failover to backup artifact available. Action: `artifact.rotate --model gptx-13b --from s3://artifacts/verified/gptx-13b/20260314` queued.

marta: starting controlled warmup on a single spare node (node-uw2-gpu-spare-02) with compile disabled. Monitoring memory and NVML metrics.

omar: spare node warmup succeeded for shard0-2, compile skipped, kv-cache warm. No driver resets. Rolling patch to swap traffic back at 30% to validate.

ops: nodes -07 and -09 replaced, -11 still under investigation (spinning).

lena: sanity check: once we hit 30% and stable for 5 min, we'll progress to 60% and then full. Customer comms updated: ETA 40m -> 25m.

ryan: oncall handoff note for next rotation: monitor nvml.reset_count and model-loader errors, keep warmup throttle enabled. If driver resets > 3 in 10m, cordon node and promote spare.

marta: postmortem action items we should capture: better artifact integrity check during deploy, backoff for customer-triggered warmups, increase compile timeout heuristics, and driver health alerting.

devon: creating incident ticket with mitigation timeline and attaching logs.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and status: partial services restored (fallback routing in place, artifact rotated). Severity: SEV2. Assigned: marta (lead), oncall: omar.

marta: thanks all. I'm staying on until _stable_ and will update channel in 10. :thumbsup:
